text:
Maya S.: Sandbar Health asked for a 6-month pilot pricing concession — 40% off Dedicated list while they run a clinical ingestion test. Need finance + legal signoff before I send revised SOW.
Jordan (FinOps): 40% exceeds delegated approval. Need ARR/commit and usage projection, and confirm this won't crowd out capacity for paid customers.
Olivia - AE: Context: medtech startup, pilot commit = $45k/mo list, avg ~300k tokens/day, spikes to 900k/day during tests. They prefer Net30. Plan to convert to reserved if SLAs met.
Ben R.: Legal question: telemedicine data flagged. They asked for DPA + customer KMS; legal needs to confirm SOC and audit language.
Maya S.: They'll take our standard DPA + KMS, no extra IP clauses. Proposing a $5k one-time onboarding credit and a pilot addendum (6 months).
Jordan (FinOps): Numbers: $45k x6 = $270k list; 40% off => $162k; minus $5k credit => $157k. Need margin sanity check. Also require Sales to document conversion trigger in Deal Desk.
finance-bot: Reminder: discounts >30% require CFO approval and Deal Desk form (https://redwood.company/deals/forms).
Olivia - AE: Filling Deal Desk now, attaching conversion projection and customer ENG contact.
Ben R.: Legal: DPA + KMS OK, no extra indemnities. Will prepare pilot addendum.
Jordan (FinOps): Confirm billing flow: if they convert mid-pilot, prorate and switch to reserved on signed date; avoid double-billing. Recommend fallback: continue usage-billed until conversion effective date.
Maya S.: Draft billing snippet: Term 6 months; Monthly in arrears Net30; 40% pilot discount; $5k onboarding credit applied to first invoice; conversion prorated.
Jordan (FinOps): Two asks before CFO: 1) LTV or conversion probability, 2) Sales agrees to price revert if no conversion within 9 months.
Olivia - AE: Deal Desk shows estimated LTV $1.2M ARR if converted; Sales accepts 9-month reversion clause.
Maya S.: Tagging @Anna (CFO) for final approval.
Anna (CFO): I see $157k effective pilot revenue and $1.2M potential ARR. 40% is high but strategic for medtech. Approved with conditions: a) clause reverting to full price if no conversion within 9 months, b) Deal Desk entry and signed legal addendum on file before first invoice.
Jordan (FinOps): Noted. I'll mark approved in Deal Desk with those conditions and notify Billing to apply $5k credit and proration rules.
Olivia - AE: Thanks — I'll send updated SOW once addendum is signed.
Maya S.: I'll attach signed addendum to Deal Desk when available. :thumbsup:
finance-bot: Deal Desk record created: https://redwood.company/deals/2290011223 (status: pending-signature).
Anna (CFO): Approved (conditions acknowledged).
Maya S.: Closing loop, moving to signature.
